descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role A professional who operates industrial machinery found in construction sites, factories, power plants, and other sectors. Responsibilities
• Disassemble, inspect, and assemble compressors, turbines, gearboxes, expanders and other rotating equipment
• Assemble machines as per instructed by Supervisor
• Possess a sufficient quantity of professional hand tools to adequately perform daily assignments
• Continuously upgrade knowledge of projects, materials and procedures to better perform duties including safety cards
• Report any instances of spillage, uncontrolled exposure or other related safety issues to their line manager.
• Ensure the correct use of waste segregation facilities and the efficient use of natural resources and raw materials.
• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Qualifications: The i d eal ca nd i d ate will p o sse s s t h e f o l l o win g :
• High School diploma or equivalent
• Valid driver’s License
• Ability to obtain a Transportation Workers Identification credentials(TWIC)
• Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interface with personnel from diverse backgrounds at all levels of the organization
• Strong mechanical aptitude and ability learn technical and design aspects for Rotating Equipment service and repairs
• Physical ability to work in a shop and field environments
• Travel is required
• Experienced in driven equipment repair such as generators, compressors, and pumps
• Experienced in alignments
• Professional presentation, in manner, attitude, appearance, speech, and dependability, to the customer at all times. What we offer you
• 401K with 6% company match Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
